name: reach-cold-call-outline
description: Builds a cold call outline in keywords, with the opening and "is this a good moment", the reason for the call in one line, two open questions, the ask with two times, what to do with two common refusals and a voicemail of about twenty seconds. Use for "run reach-cold-call-outline", "cold call outline", "cold call script", "what do I say on a cold call", "how to open a cold call", "phone outreach", "what to say after hello", "voicemail script", part of the Claude Guide for Outreach Pack by 90n.
